title: THOS: A Benchmark Dataset for Targeted Hate and Offensive Speech
findings: The paper demonstrates that its proposed dataset, THOS, can be successfully used to train Large Language Model-based classifiers to detect hate and offensive speech targeted at specific groups, including religious ones. The experimental study showed that models could classify the general topic of the speech (Topic Class, TPC), which includes 'Religion' as a category, with high accuracy (F1 scores ranging from 0.87 to 0.89).
